correctness.rationale: Opposite endpoints are required for any ordinary-unbordered discrepancy. For <=3 minority markers, equality of disjoint Parikh border counts forces an ordinary border. Four ones require two markers in each disjoint Abelian border, equivalent to a+b<=c+d after a>d; the only compatible ordinary border occurs exactly when b=d. The injective e,f,b,d gap parametrization yields the stated rational generating function, with a fourth-order pole at one and other poles of strictly lower coefficient order. Direct exhaustive checks confirmed 36,455 sparse words and 80,730 weight-four words, and independent coefficient tests through n=120.
